# Remotion SaaS

Guidance for building an app with Remotion — from a simple form hooked up to a render to a full video editor: choosing a SaaS template or framework (Next.js, React Router, Express, Vercel), embedding a preview with the <Player> component, choosing client-side or server-side rendering (Node.js, Remotion Lambda, Vercel, GitHub Actions, Azure, Cloudflare), and using Remotion with Vue, Angular or Svelte. The rendering backends are options the user chooses and sets up on their own accounts at use time — the Lambda path involves the user's own AWS credentials, kept in a .env file and never pasted into chat, per the guide itself. No licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing.
